articles.title: The FDE Bubble: Silicon Valley’s Most Expensive Game Of Pretend
articles.summary: Enterprise AI companies relying on armies of forward deployed engineers are disguising labor-intensive services as scalable software, inflating recurring revenue and valuations while falling short of autonomy claims, argues Anurag Gurtu, co-founder and CEO of Airrived. In this guest commentary he urges buyers and investors to examine deployment costs and gross margins to distinguish sustainable software businesses from expensive staffing operations.

articles.title: 'Difficult to Overstate' Volatility of White House AI Messaging, Says Greg Allen
articles.summary: Greg Allen, Founder and CEO of Decision Tree Research and former AI strategy official at the Department of Defense, said that it is 'extremely difficult to overstate' how volatile the Trump administration's messaging has been on artificial intelligence regulations as it swings between dismissing AI safety fears and requiring mandatory regulations.
